sample_unit: ChatGPT responses rated by expert authors (20 questions; 59 references evaluated)

links.outcome: Proportion of ChatGPT-provided references that were fabricated
links.effect: Of 59 references evaluated, 41 (69%) were fabricated, although they appeared real; fabricated citations used real authors, pertinent titles, and credible journal formats.
links.quote: Of the 59 references evaluated, 41 (69%) were fabricated, although they appeared real.

links.outcome: Fabricated references and factual errors in AI-generated text for medical manuscripts
links.effect: 69% of references fabricated; median quality score 60% (Q1 50%, Q3 85%); 5 major and 7 minor factual errors among 17 evaluated responses.
links.quote: Users of ChatGPT should pay particular attention to the references provided before integration into medical manuscripts.

screen.reason: Evaluates ChatGPT's baseline accuracy and citation hallucination on 20 medical questions without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
